title: These 13 Games Are Coming To Xbox Game Pass (May 20 - June 2)
summary:
May going out with a bang!

Microsoft has today unveiled another 13 games coming to Xbox Game Pass later this month and into June 2026, featuring some newly-announced additions such as Jurassic World Evolution 3 and The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition.

Before we dive into these new and upcoming titles, we also want to remind you folks that of course, Forza Horizon 6 has been added to Xbox Game Pass today and is now live for GPU subscribers. We covered that — alongside what's coming in the game's first post-launch season — down below.

summary:
Details on the first Festival Playlist & Car Pass.

Forza Horizon 6 is officially available worldwide, including a day one Xbox Game Pass release! Yep, the Standard Edition of Playground's new racer is out now for all after a good few days of paid early access, and Game Pass Ultimate players can jump in and see what Horizon Japan has to offer.

As you're all probably well aware of what Forza Horizon 6 is and how you'd describe it, we're going to spend a bit of time here detailing what's coming to the game's first post-launch season - or 'Series 1' as Playground calls it.

title: Xbox Fans Share Their Top 10 Requests After Day One Of Player Voice Feedback
summary:
Exclusives, backwards compatibility & more.

As we mentioned a few hours ago, Microsoft has officially set up a new XBOX Player Voice feedback system over on the MS Feedback Portal website, providing an all-in-one destination for Xbox fans to share their requests.

So, how is the top 10 shaping up after day one of feedback? Well, based on the upvotes that have been received so far, we can see that the return of "exclusives" is sitting in first place, closely followed by a call for more backwards compatible games and a request to make online multiplayer totally free on consoles.

title: Microsoft Announces Fan Feedback Program 'XBOX Player Voice', And It's Now Live
summary:
"A simpler way to share feedback".

Since stepping into the role, Xbox boss Asha Sharma has been keen to gather more fan feedback as she begins to shape the future of the brand, and that's now resulted in a new 'XBOX Player Voice' program being announced by Microsoft.

Unveiled today via Xbox Wire, XBOX Player Voice is "a new place to collect your feedback and make it more visible". It's a forum of sorts, where you can submit your feedback to Team Green about what you want to see moving forward.

title: Feature: Xbox Invited Us To A Real Forza Horizon Festival, And There's Another One This Weekend
summary:
A fun time, even despite the rain!

Last week, Xbox UK invited us to a special event to celebrate the launch of Forza Horizon 6, and so I decided to head over to Caffeine & Machine in Stratford-upon-Avon to see what kind of surprises they had in store.

The event was open to the public (it was on Saturday), and so there was a nice buzz about the place — lots of people enjoying the game, photographing cars, having a drink-or-two and just embracing the vibe. In terms of Forza Horizon 6, there were stations set up in multiple places, spanning everything from just standard TVs with controllers to high-spec simulator rigs. All of these proved really popular, and the general feeling seemed to be that FH6 was a fantastic game, even amongst those who weren't really there for the gaming side of things.

title: Poll: What Do You Think Of Subnautica 2 On Xbox Game Pass?
summary:
Liking what you've played so far?

With Forza Horizon 6 dominating a lot of the attention last week (and let's be honest, it's going to happen this week as well), we didn't get much chance to talk about Subnautica 2, which is now playable with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate.

To be honest, we didn't think it was going to release on time — this is a game that's suffered its fair share of behind-the-scenes controversy in recent months — but now that it's here, it feels like the reception has been pretty darn positive so far (aside from controversy about some of the wording included in the game's EULA).

title: Xbox Takes #1 Spot In Metacritic's Top 10 Video Games Of 2026 So Far
summary:
But bizarrely it doesn't top the Series X and Series S list.

We knew Forza Horizon 6 was going to review well, but it's pleasing to see just how much it's won over both the critics and most players so far — to the point where, according to Metacritic, it's the highest-rated video game of 2026 so far.

Yes, Xbox tops the list here, although it should be noted that due to how Metacritic works, FH6 isn't actually the highest-rated game for the Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. The multiplatform list is made up of technically new releases (so Hades 2 isn't eligible), and the average score for each game is made up of the platform with the most reviews.

Her tweet racked up 2.1 million views, although only 19,000+ people actually ended up voting. The final results were significantly in favour of the all caps version, with just under 65% of fans choosing this option:

title: Talking Point: So, Did You Cave And Buy Early Access For Forza Horizon 6?
summary:
Taking an early flight to Japan.

Today is Saturday, May 16th, which means Forza Horizon 6 is out now in early access and has been for more than a full day at this point. Getting in via early access comes at quite the cost, we must admit, but the team at Playground is offering up some good stuff as part of its Premium Upgrade - including a pair of future expansions.

We've been lucky and have had access to the game for a few weeks now, but we must say that we'd be pretty tempted to grab this otherwise. The whole paid early access thing does make us feel a bit uneasy generally, but Forza Horizon is such a known quantity at this point that putting your faith in it — and those future DLCs — is a pretty safe bet. It also helps that reviews have dropped before the early access launch so you know exactly what you're getting in for.

title: Beloved VR Game 'Moss' Is Finally Getting The Xbox Treatment In 2026
summary:
"One of the most celebrated modern indie adventure franchises".

A few years ago, one of the games that was all the rage in the VR space was an indie fantasy adventure title known as Moss, and after eight years, it's just been revealed that it's finally making its debut on Xbox Series X and S.

This version will be known as Moss: The Forgotten Relic, combining both Moss and Moss: Book 2 into one standalone title. In the game, you'll play as a little mouse known as Quill, with the goal being to guide your "determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection" via a mix of exploration and puzzles.

title: Xbox 'Investigating' Issue With Passwords Not Working On Consoles
summary:
“The password is incorrect. Please try again.”.

If you've run into an issue this week where your correct password isn't being accepted properly on your Xbox console, you're not alone — Xbox Support has issued a statement today confirming that the problem is being investigated.

The statement mentions that you can use a couple of workarounds in the meantime, including resetting your password and going passwordless entirely, so it sounds like they're going to need at least a few days to get to the bottom of it.

title: Five Xbox Games Are Set To Be Delisted In May & June 2026
summary:
Update: LEGO 2K Drive added to the mix.

As the new month begins, it's time once again to look at the delistings for both May and June 2026, and there's actually quite a lot going on even beyond the four games, so bear with us — this might get a little confusing.

We'll break it all down for you in a minute, but let's focus on the main delisting first in the form of Battlefield Hardline. EA's 2015 shooter is officially being delisted on May 22nd, but the good news is that it's really cheap on the Xbox Store until the middle of May, so you may as well add it to your Xbox library if you have any interest. Just keep in mind that the servers for the game are being turned off in June, so you're only really buying it for the campaign.
